DSCI 100.title: Introduction to Data Science
DSCI 100.description: Use of data science tools to summarize, visualize, and analyze data. Sensible workflows and clear interpretations are emphasized. .

DSCI 200.title: Navigating Data: Acquisition, Exploration and Management
DSCI 200.description: Acquiring data through web scraping and generating synthetic data via simulations. Sampling and experimental designs. Reporting and visualizing data and data quality. Data privacy and ownership. Emphasis on case studies and real data sets.

DSCI 220.title: Discrete Mathematics for Data Science
DSCI 220.description: Boolean algebra and logical inference, proof techniques, sets, relations and functions, regular expressions, and data filtering.
DSCI 220.prerequisiteText: All of a) DSCI_V 100 or DATA_O 101; b) MATH_V 100, MATH_V 110, MATH_V 120, MATH_V 180, SCIE_V 001 or MATH_O 100; and c) CPSC_V 103 or CPSC_V 110

DSCI 221.title: Data Structures for Data Science
DSCI 221.description: Object-oriented programming. Design and analysis of basic algorithms and data structures especially relevant to data science. Algorithm analysis methods, basic data structures, graphs and graph algorithms.
DSCI 221.prerequisiteText: (a) DSCI_V 220, or (b) CPSC_V 121 and one of CPSC_V 203, CPSC_V 210, CPEN_V 221

DSCI 310.title: Reproducible and Trustworthy Workflows for Data Science
DSCI 310.description: Data science methods to automate the running and testing of code and analytic reports, manage data analysis software dependencies, package and deploy software for data analysis, and collaborate with others using version control.
DSCI 310.prerequisiteText: One of (a) DSCI_V 221, (b) DSCI_V 100 and one of CPSC_V 203, CPSC_V 210, CPEN_V 221, or (c) DSCI_V 100, either MATH_V 210 or ECON_V 323, and either CPSC_V 107 or CPSC_V 110

DSCI 320.title: Visualization for Data Science
DSCI 320.description: Analysis, design, and implementation of static and interactive visual representations; visualization literacy; data communication; exploratory Data Analysis; application of theoretical principles to visualization development.
DSCI 320.prerequisiteText: STAT_V 201 and one of CPSC_V 203, CPSC_V 210, CPEN_V 221, DSCI_V 221

DSCI 430.title: Fairness, Accountability, Transparency and Ethics (FATE) in Data Science
DSCI 430.description: Ethical application of data science and machine learning algorithms. Application of ethical theories in real-world case studies. Data ownership, collection, and validity. Algorithm auditing, fairness and transparency. Reducing unfairness in algorithms. Deployment of predictive models and dissemination of results.
DSCI 430.prerequisiteText: One of CPSC 330, CPSC 340, STAT 301, STAT 406

DSCI 511.title: Programming for Data Science
DSCI 511.description: Pseudo-code. Program design and structure. Flow control. Iteration. Lists (arrays). Functions. File I/O. Classes, objects, methods, and libraries.

DSCI 512.title: Algorithms and Data Structures
DSCI 512.description: Basic algorithms. Recursion. Data structures including linked lists, queues, stacks, trees, graphs, and hash tables. Searching and sorting. Introduction to complexity including Big-O notation, efficiency, and scalability.

DSCI 513.title: Databases and Data Retrieval
DSCI 513.description: Relational schemas. SQL queries. Database programming using embedded SQL. XML and XQuery.

DSCI 521.title: Computing Platforms for Data Science
DSCI 521.description: Introduction to software, shells, tools, and file systems for use in the Data Science program. Installation, configuration, and use of statistical and programming software including Integrated Development Environments (IDEs). Problem resolution skills.

DSCI 522.title: Data Science Workflows
DSCI 522.description: Interactive and non-interactive data analysis. Scripting. Dynamic reporting. Reproducibility. Project and file management. Version control. Automated workflows.

DSCI 523.title: Programming for Data Manipulation
DSCI 523.description: Program design and data manipulation using industry-standard software tools designed for statistical work. Organizing, filtering, sorting, grouping, reformatting, converting, and cleaning data to prepare it for further analysis.

DSCI 524.title: Collaborative Software Development
DSCI 524.description: Software life cycle. Unit testing. Continuous integration. Submission to a relevant repository for distribution. Packaging for installation and use by others. Software licenses. Classes and abstraction.

DSCI 525.title: Web and Cloud Computing
DSCI 525.description: Networks and the Internet, scraping data, APIs, cloud computing, Web services for scalable computing, Web hosting, Web publication platforms, introduction to parallel computing.

DSCI 531.title: Data Visualization I
DSCI 531.description: Descriptive plots using statistical and programming software. Basics, mechanics, and principles of data visualization.

DSCI 532.title: Data Visualization II
DSCI 532.description: Interactive visualization, design choices, dynamic change over time, multiple views, data reduction, dealing with complexity.

DSCI 541.title: Privacy, Ethics, and Security
DSCI 541.description: Privacy and data. Ethics boards, legal issues, licensing. Physical and logical data security, social engineering. Encryption, data anonymization, privacy-preserving techniques. Case studies.

DSCI 542.title: Communication and Argumentation
DSCI 542.description: Claims, reasons, and evidence. Strengths and weaknesses of models. Effective oral and written presentation of scientific results, including interpretation of data and recognition of assumptions, bias, validity, and reliability. Citations, references, and peer-review.

DSCI 551.title: Descriptive Statistics and Probability for Data Science
DSCI 551.description: Descriptive statistics including measures of location and spread. Random variables, distributions, and parameters. Categorical variables. Uncertainty. Missing data.

DSCI 552.title: Statistical Inference and Computation I
DSCI 552.description: Random variables, parameters, observed data, statistics (distinctions and connections). Estimation: point and interval. Two-group comparisons, frequentist version. Simulation-based approaches.

DSCI 553.title: Statistical Inference and Computation II
DSCI 553.description: Multiple hypothesis testing, false discovery rate. Two-group comparisons, Bayesian paradigm.

DSCI 554.title: Experimentation and Causal Inference
DSCI 554.description: Randomization. A/B testing. Blocked designs. Orthogonality. Batch effects, confounding. Causality. Contemporary examples. Simulations.

DSCI 561.title: Regression I
DSCI 561.description: Linear models: continuous response; one or more categorical covariates and/or one or more continuous covariates.

DSCI 562.title: Regression II
DSCI 562.description: Non-parametric regression and smoothing. Data-driven parameter selection. Robust regression. Mixed effects.

DSCI 563.title: Unsupervised Learning
DSCI 563.description: Unsupervised learning. K-means/medoids. Model-based clustering. Expectation-maximization algorithm. Hierarchical clustering. Dimension reduction. Matrix decomposition. Heatmaps, contour plots, dendograms.

DSCI 571.title: Supervised Learning I
DSCI 571.description: Decision trees. k-th nearest neighbour classifiers. Naive Bayes classifiers. Logistic regression.

DSCI 572.title: Supervised Learning II
DSCI 572.description: Support Vector Machines. Random Forests. Ensemble Classifiers. Graphical models.

DSCI 573.title: Feature and Model Selection
DSCI 573.description: Performance of a classification model. Generalization error, overfitting of training data. Shrinkage, feature selection, Akaike Information Criterion, Bayesian Information Criterion. k-fold cross validation. Bootstrapping. Receiver Operating Characteristic curve. Elastic nets, regularization.

DSCI 574.title: Spatial and Temporal Models
DSCI 574.description: Time series. State space and change point detection. Hidden Markov Models. Gaussian processes.

DSCI 575.title: Advanced Machine Learning
DSCI 575.description: Neural networks trained with backpropagation. Deep learning. Overfitting and underfitting. Active data acquisition. Hyperparameter optimization.

DSCI 591.title: Capstone Project
DSCI 591.description: A capstone design project designed to give students experience in leading complex multidisciplinary projects relevant to data science.
DSCI 591.prerequisiteText: All of DSCI_V 513, DSCI_V 524, DSCI_V 525, DSCI_V 532, DSCI_V 541, DSCI_V 542, DSCI_V 554, DSCI_V 563, DSCI_V 573, DSCI_V 574, DSCI_V 575
